workstream: Wave 3C-3d1 — Ayala and Guadalupe jeepney-route reconciliation
scope: Rows 1–20 of Makati Facts and Figures 2020 jeepney-route inventory. Research only; no route assets added.
methodology: Test route-corridor continuity separately from operator/association continuity.
A current route with matching endpoints is not proof that the 2020 association acronym remains the operator.
Where multiple historical associations share one corridor, do not force a one-to-one current operator mapping.
Do not create point assets for linear routes.
